limits: Test-only control/content and SQLite outbox experiments; no production app integration, relay, transport or durable service acknowledgement contract.
Outbox trusts its synchronous sealer and caller-supplied entropy; tests use approved providers. Structural output checks do not authenticate arbitrary callback output.
Local prepared intents are plaintext. No private keys or CEKs are stored by the outbox; secret storage, secure erasure and device-at-rest encryption remain separate.
Authority, membership and authenticated writer admission remain in memory. Persistent outbox owner/actor state is not a durable trust chain.
Epoch resealing, enrollment/recovery, historical frontiers, old-writer reconciliation, authoritative snapshots and receive chains are not implemented.

Unsealed old-writer intents become recovery-required after any writer reopen, including ordinary restart. They are preserved and observable but not automatically delivered; no unsafe actor rebind or old-writer resealing.
Writer and attempt identity metadata grow without lifetime count caps. Production disk budgets, retention/compaction and storage-exhaustion recovery remain open.
Process crashes and actual SQL errors are tested on local temporary storage, not power loss, media/host loss, hardware flush faults, OS/RNG snapshots or malicious local database writes.
Structural oracle keys/signatures are placeholders; actual crypto round trips use the selected provider. Independent exact-suite hybrid HPKE/signature interoperability is not established.
